title: E-commerce Fulfillment & Order Operations Database
short_description: Designed an e-commerce operations database covering inventory, fulfillment centres, item-level shipments, status history, returns, refunds, reporting views, and SQL optimization.
long_description: Portfolio refactor of an MSc relational-database assignment. The full academic design contained 50+ tables; the recruiter-facing implementation focuses on the operational flow from inventory and fulfillment centres through order items, shipments, tracking events, returns, and refunds. Includes MySQL schema design, reporting views, warehouse-style operational queries, and a CTE-based query optimization example.

title: Excelerate Learners, Opportunities & Cohorts Analysis
short_description: Built a PostgreSQL analytics pipeline across six source datasets and produced a BI-ready model for learner, opportunity, cohort, and enrollment analysis.
long_description: Cleaned and integrated six source datasets into an analytics-ready PostgreSQL model. The final extract contains 184,782 rows, 42 columns, and 129,262 unique learners. Used CTEs, joins, COALESCE, CASE, date extraction, data-quality checks, and aggregate analysis; published privacy-safe portfolio results instead of the 149 MB learner-level dataset.

title: Zalando Marketplace Relational Schema & Analytics
short_description: Completed a Zalando-style fashion marketplace database with SKU-level variants, carts, orders, payments, shipments, returns, refunds, reviews, promotions, and analytics queries.
long_description: Converted an academic product-dissection draft into a complete PostgreSQL portfolio implementation. Added a normalized relational schema, synthetic sample data, a Mermaid ER model, constraints and indexes, plus analytical queries for brand revenue, low stock, return rate, view-to-purchase conversion, average order value, promotion sales, shipment aging, and ratings.

title: Superhero U Facebook Ads Campaign Analysis
short_description: Evaluated 11 paid campaigns across 13 countries and translated campaign KPIs into a recommendation to remove or reallocate underperforming spend.
long_description: Analyzed Facebook campaign performance for the Superhero U event using Excel and Tableau. Compared reach, spend, and efficiency indicators across campaigns, built an interactive Tableau Public dashboard, and recommended removing/reallocating weak campaigns with an estimated ~30% marketing-budget saving in the internship scenario.

title: Operation and Metric Analysis
short_description: Analyzed job and user metrics using SQL across multiple datasets to measure engagement, retention, and performance.
long_description: Analyzed job and user metrics using SQL across multiple datasets with 4 tables. Developed SQL queries to measure user engagement, retention, and performance across 325,000+ events and 90,000+ email events.

title: Instagram User Analytics
short_description: Analyzed Instagram user interactions and engagement to identify loyal users, inactive users, bot-like behavior, and campaign timing insights.
long_description: Analyzed user interactions and user engagement with the Instagram app using a database containing 7 tables. Delivered actionable insights for 3 cross-functional teams, identified the 5 most loyal users, optimal days for ad campaigns, 13% bot-like users, and 13% inactive users for re-engagement strategy.

title: Student App Data Learning Analysis
short_description: Analyzed student app usage patterns to identify engagement gaps, distractions, and opportunities for targeted coaching feedback.
long_description: Provided actionable coaching feedback by analyzing student app usage data against 3 distinct study patterns. Discovered that the student spent only 67% of test time on the test, with the remaining 33% spent on gaming the device and other distractions.

title: RFM Analysis of e-Commerce Customers
short_description: Performed RFM analysis on e-commerce customer, product, and order datasets to segment customers and identify marketing target groups.
long_description: Performed Recency, Frequency, Monetary (RFM) analysis on three datasets covering 99,990 customers, 29,000 products, and 181,000 orders to segment customers and identify key target groups for marketing strategy optimization.
